limitations: Historical absence is defined as no recorded weekly player-stat participation and is not proof of official inactive status.
Historical teammate splits are descriptive associations and should not be interpreted as causal effects.
Role changes, trades, depth-chart changes, injuries and game context can confound with/without splits.
Limited samples are heavily shrunk toward zero before a proposed adjustment is created.
V1.6 does not modify live projections, simulation histograms or JPro Picks.
A later validated activation stage must recompute affected projections and 20K distributions rather than simply transferring an absent player's projected yards.
